title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Anthropic retires Claude Sonnet 4.5 on Nov 30, 2026 — migrate to Sonnet 5.5
bullets.summary: Anthropic's Developer Platform announced Sonnet 4.5 retires Nov 30, 2026, pointing users to Sonnet 5.5; Claude for Government also went GA (FedRAMP High) on Sep 30.
bullets.how: The Construct: audit every routine, skill and script that pins a Sonnet 4.5 model ID and move it to Sonnet 5.5 before the cutoff. PRAGMA: add model-deprecation tracking to client operator runbooks.

bullets.title: Claude Code Mods (v2.1.287/2.1.288) — TypeScript functions that rewrite prompts, UI and built-ins
bullets.summary: Mods let users change how Claude Code works via TypeScript hook functions; 2.1.288 adds smarter resume/recovery and stronger plugin/MCP handling.
bullets.how: The Construct: use mods for status lines, guardrails and per-agent prompt shaping; re-test long-running scheduled routines on the new resume/recovery flow.

bullets.title: OpenAI unveils always-on 'dots' personal agent at DevDay amid reported $1.4T valuation talks
bullets.summary: OpenAI launched 'dots', a persistent personal agent, while reports surfaced of funding talks at a roughly $1.4T valuation.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: persistent operator agents are now a mainstream consumer category — sharpen the 'business-grade operator' positioning. The Construct: evaluate event-driven triggers over pure cron.

bullets.title: Instinct raises $1B at $10B; EliseAI $350M (housing) and Homeward $120M (real estate) lead the week's rounds
bullets.summary: Crunchbase's weekly list (Sep 26–Oct 2) is almost entirely AI: Instinct (AI assistants) $1B Series C, EliseAI $350M at $4B, Armadin $255.5M.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: vertical operator agents for housing/real estate are heavily funded — validate community/builder-facing offers for Brand 9 Signs' master-planned-community buyers.

bullets.title: Microsoft ships MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming, its first real-time speech-to-text model for voice agents
bullets.summary: Microsoft's streaming transcription model targets ultra-realistic, low-latency voice agents.
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: voice intake agent for quote requests and install scheduling. PRAGMA: a component for client voice-operator builds; compare latency/cost against current STT.

praxis_lesson: Model and tooling lifecycles are accelerating (Sonnet 4.5 retiring, Claude Code mods, new MCP/transcription stacks), so pinned model IDs and hard-coded tooling become silent liabilities. Keep a registry of every pinned model and tool version across Construct jobs, and review it on each deprecation notice.
